description: Roadside Conservation - Road Centerline (DBCA-030) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Biodiversity, Conservation and Attractions. The Roadside Conservation Committee (RCC) surveys were initiated to assist Local Government Authorities (LGAs) and local communities in the protection, maintenance and improvement of roadside vegetation. The roadside assessment mapping and data are generated with GIS (Geographic Information Systems) software. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Biodiversity, Conservation and Attractions. Its tags are Harvested, SLIP Future, biodiversity, conservation, environment. It offers 9 resource(s) in API ARCGIS SERVER MAP SERVICE, FGDB, GEOJSON, GEOPACKAGE, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Share Alike 4.0 International. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
